description: Rung 7 of DETERMINEX_LIVE_REACT_UNIFIED_PRODUCT_SHELL_SERIES. First Learning Studio rung that GENERATES content -- rung 6 (DETERMINEX_LEARNING_STUDIO_WORKFLOW_LOCK_001) only validated a supplied LearningStudioOutput; nothing ever produced one. scripts/ide/learning_studio_content.py grounds all 9 modes (explain_this_repo, explain_this_file, explain_this_error, explain_this_test_failure, teach_me_the_concept, compare_possible_fixes, walk_me_through_the_patch, show_beginner_vs_professional_version, generate_learning_checklist) in determinex_corpus_api.py (the new read-only corpus query surface) plus real filesystem reads for repo/file structural summaries -- an unmatched query honestly says so instead of fabricating an explanation. Every generated output is still routed through learning_studio_workflow.evaluate() before reaching the frontend, so the non-authorizing gate applies to GENERATED content exactly as it applied to rung 6's placeholder. New Tauri command generate_learning_studio_content wired end-to-end: Python backend_command_surface.py -> _tauri_driver.py -> Rust ide_repair_bridge.rs #[tauri::command] -> lib.rs tauri::generate_handler! -> frontend LearningStudioPanel.tsx (context textarea + Generate button + rendered output). Deliberately excluded from both the Python UNIFIED_PRODUCT_READ_ONLY_COMMANDS frozenset and the matching Rust const array (it takes real args and does per-call computation, unlike the static view-model snapshots those pinned sets represent -- same category as preview_idea_oracle/repair_diagnose/build_idea, which also live outside those sets).
purpose: Rung 7 of DETERMINEX_LIVE_REACT_UNIFIED_PRODUCT_SHELL_SERIES -- Learning Studio content generation, grounded in the verified corpus, never fabricated.
